security_justification.audit_integrity: The result no longer claims a business commit for a not_committed occurrence, and a failure after the commit is no longer reported as one before it; occurrences themselves are unchanged.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization logic changes; the binding still refuses foreign classes and unknown event names before any probe or gate.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Commit state is read from the occurrence the SDK built from its operation handle; the binding adds no new authority and trusts no new caller input.
security_justification.concurrency: Admission and reservation stay decided in one synchronous step; the uncommitted path reserves and releases exactly like the committed path.
security_justification.confidentiality: Results carry only event id, transaction id, status, code and two booleans; no occurrence content or caller value is echoed.
security_justification.cryptography: No algorithm, identifier, key or digest changes; the deduplication key is unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Two new fixed refusal codes join the existing set; no caught error, gate value or probe value is exposed.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The handoff, fetch adapter and collector are unchanged; the consumer integration profile is corrected to the new behaviour.
security_justification.fail_posture: Out-of-type probe and gate values now fail closed instead of open, and every failure still records whether the gate ran and durability was attempted.
security_justification.lifecycle: The fixed probe, gate, durability order is preserved; only not_committed skips the gate, and other commit states are unchanged.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: One production source file, one new top-level test file and enumerated documentation; no other delivery class, export or shared type changes.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No transformation hook, privacy policy or field projection changes; the occurrence is handed off unchanged.
security_justification.resource_retention: The in-memory settled and reserved sets are unchanged in scope; per-instance deduplication is documented, not extended.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The binding still makes exactly one handoff attempt; a failed pair stays retryable, and no persistent retry is added or claimed.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Probe and gate results are treated as untrusted runtime values whatever their declared types, so a JavaScript host or cast cannot make the binding fail open.
